facts.fact: INTIC reports that Law 13/2026 (Cyber Security Law), in force from 29 September 2026, designates INTIC as National Cybersecurity Authority and establishes the national CSIRT, operated by INTIC.

INTIC reports that with Law 13/2026 in force, incident reporting became mandatory for entities in the national cybersecurity ecosystem, including critical infrastructure operators and essential service operators.
